GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2017-06-26T20:51:16Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: QueryBuilder Update seems to generate incorrect SQL statement for MSSQL
Description: QueryBuilder's update() seems to generate:

UPDATE Table1 Alias SET Column1="Value1" ...

Whereas I think MSSQL only accepts:

UPDATE Alias SET Column1="Value1" FROM Table1 Alias ...


You must provide a category number (1-3). Your response must follow this format exactly:

CATEGORY: [category number]
REASONING: [your reasoning here, including specific reasons why an issue would be hard to dockerize if choosing category 3]
llm_response:
CATEGORY: 1
REASONING: This issue is about incorrect SQL statement generation for MSSQL in the QueryBuilder's update() method. The problem is clearly described: the QueryBuilder generates "UPDATE Table1 Alias SET..." syntax while MSSQL requires "UPDATE Alias SET... FROM Table1 Alias..." syntax. This is a purely syntactical issue that can be verified through code analysis without needing to build or run the code. An LLM can analyze the SQL statement formats and confirm whether the described behavior is correct according to MSSQL's syntax requirements. No actual database connection or execution environment is needed to verify if the solution correctly generates the proper SQL syntax pattern.
